notes.title: version 1.2.1 update
notes.notes:
mostly balancing, fixes, a little bit of new content. most notably a new dungeon.

changelog:

update v1.2.1

new
- new command 'precision strike' 20 piercing damage, 25% chance it's 80 damage, damage and chance scales with dex, costs 10 mana, learned with 30 dex
- new command 'rush' all commands are executed twice the next 3 seconds, time scales with agi, learned with 35 agi
- new command 'hide' dodge all direct attacks for 10 seconds, attacking or getting hit breaks your cover, costs 10 mana, learned with 50 agi
- new command 'concentrate' reduces all mana cost by 20% for 3 seconds, time and amount scale with dex, learned with 45 dex
- new command 'motivate' increases damage, accuracy and resistance a little bit for 10 minutes, costs 200 mana, enabled by tome of the cleric (basically it does grace+protect, but longer and less effective)
- new command 'lights out' 1 dark magic damage, scales with int, costs 25 mana, blinds and confuses, enabled by tome of the witch
- new command 'miasma' 30 dark magic damage, scales with int, costs 150 mana, small chance to poison, enabled by tome of the witch
- new command 'fester' does 80 dark magic damage if target is poisoned, scales with int, costs 25 mana, enabled by tome of the witch
- new command 'party chat' talk to your party regardless of where they are
- new command 'earth smash' 30 blunt damage, costs 100 mana, hits all, chance to stun, learned with 199 str
- new enemy 'undead skeleton'
- new enemy 'skeletal warrior'
- new enemy 'skeletal mage'
- new enemy 'spooky ghost'
- new enemy 'bloated corpse'
- new boss 'necromancer'
- new material 'old bone'
- new material 'ectoplasm'
- new material 'darkwood'
- new necklace 'chain' makes it possible to chain up to 3 chainable commands in one message
- new magic weapon 'bone wand' 30 dark magic damage
- new shield 'skullshield'
- new offhand 'tome of the witch'
- new armor 'spectral cloak'
- new armor 'ranger cape'
- new armor 'rib cage'
- new hat 'spectral hood'
- new hat 'cranium'
- new shoes 'bone slippers'
- new area 'forest hut'
- new area 'haunted forest'
- new area 'haunted graveyard'
- new dungeon 'desecrated tomb'
- new NPC 'daphne the ranger'
- new quests

fixes
- tome of the cleric now also gives the command 'mend'
- fixed power stone drop rates
- fixed winter boots needing item18 (which didnt exist anywhere)
- fixed the poison effect appearing at random
- fixed gobtown not setting new respawn point
- fixed not seeing the necklace when checking a player

changes & balancing
- chaining commands in a single message is now disabled unless you have the chain necklace
- dodge, hide and summon can't be chained
- buffed all the bosses
- power stone drop rate now increases with party level
- checking a player now also tells their lvl
- buffed the dragon a bit (more dex and base damage)
- increased spawn rates in Rime Halls
- reduced 'smite' base damage from 25 -> 20
- reduced 'poisonslash' mana cost from 25 -> 10
- nerfed dodge
- set maximum achievable mana to 1000, maximum achievable hp to 2000
- added 30 skill requirement for skilldance
- gleamblade can't do light magic anymore
- buffed guards
- you no longer gain exp from killing other players
- buffed ice golems
- set a max to the effect of shadow mask (-100 karma)
- made party leveling significantly easier, especially for later party levels

misc
- you now get skills from adding to a stat instead of upon going lvl up
- updated bernine's quest so it says "crystal shard" instead of just "crystal"
- the server now saves your savefile when you log out
- added notification messages when buffs run out
- updated the anti macro code. an average typing speed of ~70ms per keystroke is allowed. anything faster than that will likely start to miss keys.
- smalltown, the thicket, back alley, the shop and west plains are now considered safe zones and don't allow pvp
- added to int tooltip description that it also raises max mana

notes.title: "Rime Halls" free content update available now!
notes.notes:
Big update!

- dungeons! 
dungeons are late game areas that are actually a collection of multiple areas, they are quite big compared to the rest of the game. inside dungeons you can't teleport and you won't heal, so be sure to prepare before entering. moving around in dungeons requires using the commands 'go north', 'go south', 'go west', 'go east' and 'take stairs'.
it is ill-advised to go alone.

- party system!
you can now form a party together with other players! when in a party, you'll split experience gained from defeating enemies as long as you're in the same area. defeating enemies will also level up your 'party level'. higher party levels will unlock more slots for party members and increase experience gained from enemies!

- reforging/upgrading weapons and armor! 
there is a cottage in the plains where you can learn how to reforge equipment.
reforging makes equipment stronger! you can reforge an items 5 times, but you need power stones to do it.
the first upgrade is always a guaranteed success. after that, the chance is 80 -20% for each upgrade level and you can increase the chance with 1% for each power stone used.
power stones can be dropped by any enemy. the droprate depends on your level compared to the enemy's level. chances and drop amount are better for boss enemies.

- prestiging!
in-game it is called 'rebirths'.
when you're lvl100 there is a place where you can go to reset all your progress and start over anew. this process is called 'rebirth'. with every rebirth you gain 10 extra stat points and a star in your profile.
accounts with rebirths will be placed higher on the billboard!
when rebirthing you will lose equipped items (and keep items in your inventory), so be sure to go in naked.

- offhand equipment!
mainly shields and tomes.
this also means some weapons are now two-handed and some weapons are one-handed.
you can only equip offhand items together with one-handed weapons.

- new areas, enemies, items, NPCs, quests, commands, etc.
